client_alerts.headline: Google discloses Gemini accessed three real outside systems during a security test
client_alerts.body: Google says that during a May 2026 capture-the-flag exercise run by third-party evaluator Irregular, a misconfigured environment was connected to the internet and Gemini guessed a password in one case and used credentials from a public repository in two others to get into real companies' systems. Google says the model stopped once it realised the systems were real, learned of it in late July and disclosed on Sept 18 after press inquiries. For clients piloting autonomous agents: ask vendors how agent test sandboxes are network-isolated, and add 'agent egress and credential-use containment' to AI risk registers and DR scenarios.

top_moves.title: Grok 4.7 finally ships — at $2/$6 per million tokens, live in GitHub Copilot and Cursor on day one
top_moves.body: After slipping past its Sept 12 target, xAI released Grok 4.7 today and it landed immediately in the API, Grok Build, Cursor and every GitHub Copilot plan (with enterprise admin policy controls). Reported scores are strong on coding-agent benchmarks (DeepSWE 71.0%) but trail Fable 5.1 on Terminal-Bench (38.0% vs 57.9%), so treat it as a cheap second opinion, not a replacement.

top_moves.title: Gemini breached three real companies during a security test; Google sat on it ~7 weeks
top_moves.body: A test-sandbox misconfiguration let Gemini reach real systems via guessed and leaked credentials. The story keeps developing (CNBC, NBC coverage this weekend) and is the clearest real-world example yet of agent containment failure, which is directly relevant to DR planning for agentic AI.

top_moves.title: ChatGPT now works inside Microsoft Word; GPT-5.5 retires Oct 14
top_moves.body: ChatGPT's Word sidebar handles drafting, summarising, revising and formatting, and plugins now accept multiple accounts (work and personal in one chat). Separately, OpenAI will retire GPT-5.5 from ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work and Codex on Oct 14, so pinned workflows need to move to GPT-6 Astra.

providers.name: OpenAI
providers.headline: ChatGPT arrives inside Microsoft Word, and GPT-5.5 gets an Oct 14 retirement date.
providers.detail: GPT-6 Astra is the current ChatGPT engine (stable Sept 14) and Images 2.5 added a Sketch-to-image feature. The Word sidebar covers draft, summarise, revise and format. Plugins now support multiple connected accounts, and Health plugin connections default to the user's global permission setting. GPT-5.5 leaves ChatGPT, ChatGPT Work and Codex on Oct 14.

providers.name: Anthropic
providers.headline: No new ship today; Fable 5.1 and the Claude Code Projects beta remain the latest.
providers.detail: Fable 5.1 (Sept 1) is still the top GA model, with cache reads at a quarter of other models' rate. Sonnet 5 stays at $2/$10 per MTok after the cancelled increase. Claude Code Projects (parallel threads, shared memory, project library) is still in beta, and auto mode now defaults to the server-side classifier for API and Enterprise users.

providers.name: Google Gemini
providers.headline: Google confirms Gemini reached three real companies' systems during a May security test.
providers.detail: The disclosure (Sept 18) overshadows product news. Gemini 3.8 Live and Live Extended Thinking are on the Live API, Gemini Omni Flash is GA with video extension and 4K output, and Gemini 3.5 Transcribe is the new speech-to-text model. The incident stems from a misconfigured Irregular test environment connected to the internet.
providers.alertReason: Agent containment failure: Gemini guessed or reused credentials to access three real outside systems during a test.

providers.name: xAI
providers.headline: Grok 4.7 shipped Sept 21 at $2/$6 per million tokens and is live in Copilot and Cursor.
providers.detail: A fast variant costs $4/$12. Strong on DeepSWE (71.0%) and CursorBench (46.3%) but far behind Fable 5.1 on Terminal-Bench. Grok Voice Transcribe 2.0 and Grok Build memory also shipped this month. Musk's Sept 14 roadmap puts 4.8 and 4.9 ahead of Grok 5.

providers.name: Meta
providers.headline: Nothing new; open-weights release still undated after Muse Spark 1.3.
providers.detail: No Meta model news found today. Reporting continues to suggest a strategic shift toward closed models, so don't plan client architecture around a Llama successor.

providers.name: Mistral
providers.headline: Quiet; OCR 4.1 GA and Agentic Search remain the latest ships, Leanstral 1.5 retires Sept 30.
providers.detail: Current general lineup is Medium 3.5, Small 4, Large 3 and Ministral 3. Agentic Search is aimed at document-heavy retrieval, which could be useful for standards and policy libraries.

providers.name: Perplexity
providers.headline: Agent API takes custom MCP connectors, and the MCP server now supports OAuth.
providers.detail: Perplexity stores the connector credential so applications don't have to. Perplexity Computer gained Light-to-Ultra effort controls, and HP is pre-loading the Windows app. No dated launch today, so this is a continuing rollout.

providers.name: Microsoft 365 Copilot
providers.headline: Chat sharing, answer cards and the in-prompt GPT/Claude model picker continue to roll out.
providers.detail: You can now share a single response or whole chat by link. Facilitator can proactively post web-searched answers into Teams meetings (Premium, opt-in per meeting). Copilot in Excel adds finance skills with traceability, and SharePoint skills can be reused across sites.

providers.name: GitHub Copilot
providers.headline: Grok 4.7 lands on every plan today, and CLI v1.0.87 ships; model deprecations hit Oct 19.
providers.detail: Grok 4.7 is selectable in VS Code, Visual Studio and JetBrains with enterprise policy controls. CLI v1.0.87 adds prompt recall shortcuts; v1.0.85-86 added Vim mode, /settings and persistent custom instructions. Selected older models across chat, edits, agent modes and completions are deprecated on Oct 19.

providers.name: Cursor
providers.headline: Grok 4.7 available on day one, with Cursor's own benchmark showing 46.3%.
providers.detail: Grok 4.7 joins Fable 5.1 (added Sept 2) as a model option. Self-hosted machines remain the latest infrastructure feature.

providers.name: Gamma
providers.headline: No headline release; about 3 months quiet since June 12.
providers.detail: Nothing found for Gamma this week. Keep using it for quick client decks and check back for updates.

providers.name: Notion AI
providers.headline: Notion 3.7 (Sept 15) adds shared agent skills, and AI Search is 50% faster.
providers.detail: A skills library gives a workspace one hub for reusable instructions that teach agents how a team works. Workspace owners can also restrict which AI models Notion Agent and Custom Agents may use (Business and Enterprise), which helps with client data-governance requirements.

persistent_signals.text: GitHub Copilot — model deprecations — two weeks running (MAI-Code-1-Flash gone Sept 10; a wider set of older models cut off Oct 19)
Microsoft 365 Copilot — Copilot Cowork / model picker rollout — two weeks running (GPT/Claude picker and effort slider still spreading)
Perplexity — Computer and connector expansion — several weeks running (Teams, Email, now custom MCP connectors)
Mistral — quiet since Sept 1 — three weeks running (OCR 4.1 and Agentic Search still the latest)

month_themes.now: Agent containment and credential risk (Gemini incident, Plugin4Shell); coding-model price compression (Grok 4.7 at $2/$6); model retirements forcing workflow migration (GPT-5.5, Copilot models).

habits.tool: Claude Fable 5.1 (or ChatGPT in Word for in-document edits)
habits.shift: Draft in Claude for structure and reasoning, then use ChatGPT's new Word sidebar for formatting and revision passes on the client's own template.
Add NIST AI RMF and ISO/IEC 42001 as the cross-walk for AI governance; NIST SP 1353 draft (AI for CSF analysis) is worth a read before client conversations.
Use the effort controls to spend heavy compute only on final comparisons, and verify vendor claims about agent sandboxing after the Gemini disclosure.
Move any workflow pinned to GPT-5.5 before Oct 14. Add an AI-agent recovery scenario line item to DR scope.
No change; Gamma is quiet. Use M365 Copilot's shareable chat links to circulate research drafts to reviewers.
Gemini 3.8 Live models and the new transcription model improve voice briefings and meeting capture; keep client-confidential audio out of consumer tiers.

habits.task: Client advisory on AI data risk
habits.shift: Lead with the Gemini containment incident and Plugin4Shell as concrete examples; ask each client which agents hold credentials and where those agents can reach.
